summary: Aspen Insurance Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K on August 18, 2026 disclosing post-acquisition integration transactions completed on August 14, 2026. Following Sompo International's acquisition of Aspen on February 24, 2026, Aspen contributed its shares in Aspen Bermuda Limited to Aspen Re America, Inc., and Aspen (UK) Holdings Limited transferred Aspen U.S. Holdings, Inc. to Endurance U.S. Holdings Corp., which issued $2.722 billion of intragroup debt. AUSH then merged into EUSH. Sompo International guaranteed Aspen's 5.750% senior notes due 2030 and provided a keepwell agreement supporting preference share dividends. This internal reorganization simplifies Aspen's corporate structure and harmonizes operations with Sompo. Watch for further integration steps and potential delisting or note treatment changes.
